instructions.content: Never leave a non-file target undeclared in .PHONY; if a file with that name exists, Make treats the target as up to date and silently skips it.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER use make recursively instead of $(MAKE)
instructions.content: Never call bare make inside a recipe; use $(MAKE) so the parent's -j jobserver, -n, and -k flags propagate to the sub-make.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER rely on shell environment variables in recipes without declaring them as Make variables
instructions.content: Never assume a recipe inherits an environment variable; declare anything the recipe needs as a Make variable instead.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER use implicit rules for critical build targets
instructions.content: Never rely on Make's implicit pattern rules for a target whose build correctness matters; write an explicit rule instead.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER put multi-line logic in recipe shells without .ONESHELL or explicit line continuations
instructions.content: Never write a cd on one recipe line expecting it to affect the next line; each recipe line is its own subshell unless .ONESHELL is set or lines are joined with a backslash.
Declare user-overridable variables (CC, CFLAGS, PREFIX, DESTDIR) with ?=, not plain =.
Declare project-internal computed variables (SOURCES, OBJECTS) with :=, not =, to avoid repeated re-evaluation.

instructions.original_snippets: Use order-only prerequisites (|) for large projects with many targets
instructions.content: Use an order-only prerequisite (|) for a build-directory dependency so directory-timestamp changes don't trigger unnecessary rebuilds.
Indent every recipe line with a real tab character, never spaces.
Quote Make variables when they are expanded inside a recipe's shell command.

instructions.original_snippets: Document with ## comments for help target
instructions.content: Tag every user-facing target with a trailing ## comment so a help target can extract and list them.

instructions.original_snippets: install target uses the install command, not cp, and creates the target directory first
instructions.content: Use the install command for the install target rather than cp, and create the destination directory first.

instructions.original_snippets: Automatic dependency tracking with -MMD -MP flags and generated .d file includes
instructions.content: Enable automatic header dependency tracking with -MMD -MP and include the generated .d files.
